_help: Scouting Corner watch list. One line per player: name (as the ITF / Tennis Europe spell it; other spellings split by |), g = M or F, nat = 3-letter nation (e.g. GBR) and born are optional but make the linking safer. If the site says a link is unsure, add the right id: itf = the number in their ITF profile link, te = the long code in their Tennis Europe profile link. Names added with the box on the site go to the Google Sheet instead.
